checks.name: both fundamental signs and constant difference
checks.scope: Exact decaying Gaussian input and both signed antiderivatives; reversed backward sign gives minus the input. Distributional and compact-support claims use the written transpose proof.

checks.name: entire kernel coordinate transpose and input twist
checks.scope: Exact invertible four-variable Jacobian; includes tau=0 flow covectors and tau-nonzero diagonal covectors.

checks.name: both-frequency half-line asymptotic and nonvanishing
checks.scope: Exact transform of H(v)exp(-a*v), with positive a. This integrable exponential model tests the sign and second-order remainder; the compact smooth-cutoff proof is the two integrations in RP7a.

checks.name: time-translation commutator and failed absolute-time cutoff
checks.scope: Exact sum of both time derivatives; spatial factors allowed. The general compact difference-cutoff construction and full symbol remainder are the written proof.

checks.name: positive degree reduction and radial characteristic
checks.scope: Full Hamilton product rule for a nonconstant homogeneous degree-two symbol, degree-one reduction, and exact x*xi radial field. Flow invariance uses the earlier full uniqueness proof.

checks.name: smooth primitive sign and conormal order
checks.scope: Exact mixed-variable primitive and eleven ambient/phase dimension balances, retaining the ambient dimension 2n.

checks.name: signed finite Volterra controls and exact interval factors
checks.scope: Finite quadrature operators satisfy the interval-product bound; continuous constant-input examples attain its factors. General L2 continuity is proved by Cauchy-Schwarz and product integration.

generality_guard: Finite and exact model checks support the written general distribution, wavefront, support and propagation proofs; they do not certify those theorems.
